heading: INT. MINIVAN - CAR WASH TUNNEL - DAY

units.text: INT. MINIVAN - CAR WASH TUNNEL - DAY
Soap foam pours down the windshield.
Giant blue brushes slap the roof.
The conveyor drags the van forward at a crawl.
GUS PAPADAKIS (40s, driver, tie loosened) grips the wheel though he doesn't have to.
In the passenger seat, MIRABEL (10, glittery backpack, face pressed to the glass) watches the brushes.
In the back, TOBIAH (7, missing teeth, a plastic dinosaur in each fist) bounces.
Beside him, NANA ZOFIA (80s, handbag on her lap, church hat pinned in place) watches the foam as if it were a sermon.
Everybody seat belts?
units.name: GUS

units.text: Yes.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Yes!
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: I have been wearing seat belts since before you were a thought.
units.name: NANA ZOFIA

units.text: Thank you, Mama.
units.name: GUS

units.text: A giant brush slams the windshield.
Mirabel shrieks.
Tobiah shrieks louder, delighted.
Nana Zofia clutches her handbag and pulls her hat down over her ears.
Dad, you said it wasn't scary!
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: It's not scary.
units.name: GUS

units.text: It's literally attacking us!
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Stegosaurus, hold on. Hold on, T. rex.
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: The conveyor jerks.
The van lurches.
Gus slams the brake, and everything stops, foam sliding down the windows, brushes humming.
Don't panic. Don't panic.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Mirabel and Tobiah grab each other.
Nana Zofia grabs Gus by the shoulder, hard.
All three of them stare through the foam at the red light ahead.
Auguste. What did you do?
units.name: NANA ZOFIA

units.text: I didn't do anything.
units.name: GUS

units.text: You pressed the button.
units.name: NANA ZOFIA

units.text: Which button?
units.name: GUS

units.text: The one that says "Do Not Press."
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Silence.
The brushes spin down.
The foam thins.
Water ticks off the roof.
Through the windshield they see the exit, ten feet away, a rectangle of white daylight.
Are we dead?
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: We're in a car wash.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Is it heaven?
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: If it were heaven, there would be no tip jar.
units.name: NANA ZOFIA

units.text: Gus starts to laugh, then Mirabel, then Tobiah.
Nana Zofia holds out for another three seconds, and then breaks.
The conveyor restarts.
The van rolls out into the sun, shining.
